caption: The drawing depicts a wooden window grille with vertical, evenly spaced spindles framed in a rectangular shape. The grille is composed of brown wooden elements with a slightly curved top and bottom, and the vertical spindles feature decorative turning. The window structure appears attached to a pale beige wall, giving the appearance of depth and shadow around the frame. Behind the grille, there is a visible window frame with a lighter brown tone, and a small portion of light blue sky or background is visible through the window opening. The artist’s signature, “ALBERT PRATT,” is written in small, faint letters near the bottom right corner of the image. The composition is centered on the page, with ample empty space around the window grille.
title: Wood Grille
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
